integrity: Symbolic proof with supplementary finite numerical checks; no external independent validation claimed.
model_scope: Fixed pollinator abundance; finitely many floral rewards with constant positive renewal, linear degradation and consumption, equal profitability per unit reward, and positive-speed replicator foraging adaptation; all rewards and preferences initially positive.
scientific_limitations: No changing species abundance, nonlinear handling, stochasticity, or heterogeneous reward value. The inverse-time result is two-source only. A closely relevant supplementary toy-model appendix could not be retrieved, so historical priority remains provisional.
title: Global convergence, nested diet activation, and inverse-time criticality for renewable floral rewards
